subject: science
title: Grade 6 Science — Set 2
description: Cells, photosynthesis, gravity, and the human body

questions.question: What is called the 'powerhouse of the cell'?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria produce energy (ATP) for the cell through cellular respiration — hence the "powerhouse".

questions.question: Which gas is released by plants during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Plants release oxygen as a by-product of photosynthesis. They absorb CO₂ and water to make glucose.

questions.question: What force pulls objects toward the Earth?
questions.explanation: Gravity is the force of attraction between masses. Earth's gravity pulls everything toward its centre.

questions.question: Which type of nutrition do plants follow?
questions.explanation: Plants are autotrophs — they make their own food using sunlight (photosynthesis).

questions.question: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.explanation: An adult human has 206 bones. Babies are born with about 270 bones; many fuse together as we grow.
